messages.author: 5f4eab8403460b4e
messages.subject: getmeta function for actigraph GT3X+
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to run the GGIR code on some data from actigraph GT3X+ accelerometers. I am having success with some data files, but not with others. The error seems to be in the getmeta function. For some data files, I get the following error:

> M = g.getmeta(datafile)
[1] "Loading block: 1"
[1] "Actigraph in csv-format"
Error in 1:floor(sampleshift) : NA/NaN argument

For other data files, it seems to work just fine. These are the raw csv files exported from actifile, without timestamps. 

Thanks,
Kat

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] getmeta function for actigraph GT3X+
parts:
Can you please try re-running your analyses with input parameter chunksize = 0.3
This will then load the data in smaller chunks, which is good for memory utilisation. It takes longer to process but may just about fix your problem.

If that does not work, please try to replicate what you did on a different more powerful PC.

If that does not work then it may be worth checking whether the measurement is not too short, which is probably something you can verify via Actilife software directly or by comparing file sizes. If a measurement is too short then the code should deal with that, but it could be that the code for doing this is not optimal for actigraph data. If, so then this is something i would then have to fix.

Thanks,
Vincent

Thanks
